proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three obligations are for the same function and share the same definitional xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg prefix induction and list normalization. The group has 3 witnesses, below the limit of 12, and keeping the entry split with the two inverse refolds lets one worker reuse the same segment-boundary reasoning without any cross-group helper dependency.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: First unfold xizi_dll, xizi_dllseg, xizi_dll_links and the case-specific list constructor only as needed. For the entry witness, retain the sentinel links, induct over nodes_before to expose linklist_pre, then destruct nodes_after; the empty suffix yields the first assertion branch, while old_next :: rest yields the second. For each return witness, prove the left Coq disjunct, rewrite nodes_after using PreH1, and fold the complete chain back through xizi_dllseg by induction over nodes_before, finally applying the xizi_dll wrapper. Use the explicit non-null hypotheses and spatial disjointness to discharge node-versus-sentinel side conditions.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: A segment from first/prev to anchor/anchor_prev over prefix, framed with anchor links and a segment from next/anchor to stop/last over suffix, entails the combined segment over prefix ++ anchor :: suffix.

premises.premise: anchor is non-null and the boundary resources are compatible with anchor <> stop
premises.discharged_by: PreH2/PreH3 for the named nodes and separation of the anchor link cells from the sentinel link cells; existing segment conjuncts discharge internal-node guards
premises.spatial_resource: prefix xizi_dllseg, anchor next/prev points-to cells, and suffix xizi_dllseg

expected_helpers: Optional group-suffixed segment append/fold helper; direct induction inside each witness is also valid.
